settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Manage your profile and account settings

sessions.heading: Active sessions
sessions.intro: Devices that are signed in to your account. End any session you do not recognise.
sessions.revoke_others_note: Every other device must sign in again. The session on this device keeps running.

profile.heading: Profile
profile.intro: Update your name and email address
profile.name: Name
profile.resend: Click here to resend the verification email.
profile.sent: A new verification link has been sent to your email address.

security.heading: Change password
security.intro: Make sure your account uses a long, random password

two_factor.heading: Two-factor authentication
two_factor.enabled_note: When you log in, you will be asked for a code from the authenticator app on your phone.
two_factor.disabled_note: When two-factor authentication is enabled, you will be asked for a code from the authenticator app on your phone when you log in.
two_factor.required_note: Your account must use two-factor authentication before it can open Administration. Turn it on now with the authenticator app on your phone.
two_factor.required_enabled_note: Your account must use two-factor authentication, so it cannot be turned off here. If you lose your device, use a recovery code or ask an administrator for a 2FA reset.
two_factor.modal_enabled_description: Two-factor authentication is now enabled. Scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app.
two_factor.modal_verify_description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
two_factor.modal_setup_description: To finish, scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app
two_factor.fetch_qr_failed: The QR code could not be fetched.
two_factor.fetch_key_failed: The setup key could not be fetched.
two_factor.fetch_codes_failed: The recovery codes could not be fetched.

recovery.title: 2FA recovery codes
recovery.intro: Recovery codes let you regain access if you lose your 2FA device. Store them in a secure password manager.
recovery.note: Each code can be used once and is removed after use. If you need new codes, use the regenerate button above.
